fields.label: Stage Field
fields.description: The field that moves the document: status, workflow_state, or any field a Kanban board uses for its columns.

fields.label: From
fields.description: Leave empty for any value. Set From or To (or both).

fields.label: To
fields.description: Leave empty for any value: the rule then fires whenever the document leaves From.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description:
Must be true for the move. Python, with doc (the document after the move) and read-only frappe.db.exists / get_value / count / get_all.
Examples: doc.custom_pricing_status == "Priced" · frappe.db.exists("Quotation", {"opportunity": doc.name, "docstatus": ["!=", 2]})

fields.label: Action
fields.description: A button shown with the Message when the condition fails: form · route:/app/... · map:dotted.path.make_x · or an action a Client Script registers with nexlify.kanban.action(name, fn).

fields.label: Step Label
fields.description: The short line the flow shows, e.g. "Production finished pricing". Empty: the Message is used.

fields.label: Waiting On
fields.description: When someone else does this step (e.g. Production), the flow says so instead of showing the Action.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Order of the steps within a stage; the first unmet one is the next step.

fields.label: Confirm View
fields.description: A method that returns {title, html} to show before the move, with Confirm and Cancel. A whitelisted Python method or an API Server Script (which sets frappe.flags.result). It receives doctype, name and to.

fields.label: Confirm Label
fields.description: The Confirm button's text. Default: Confirm

fields.label: Open Form on Move
fields.description: A Kanban drag to this column opens the form with the new value set, so the form's Client Scripts run. The card moves when the form is saved.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Shown when a save is blocked: above the missing fields, or alone when the Condition fails. Can hold HTML, including action buttons.

fields.label: Role That Can Skip
fields.description: Users with this role can move documents without the required fields, e.g. for imports of old data.
